dedupe_keys.name: parking zones linked to street segments

description: Parking zones linked to street segments is a dataset listed in City of Melbourne Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. This dataset contains each parking zone and the street segment that it is linked to. The parking zone can go across multiple street segments and also one street segment can have multiple parking zones. This data can be linked to both the sign plate parking zone dataset. The dataset(s) can be joined on parking zone. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are parking, street, travel, zones. The portal shows 926 records. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melbourne-vic-gov-au-portal.
